LLBG.notes: QAS (Quality Airport Services Israel), USD. Source proformas QAS-27097 (A6-AFA, GL6T 45.1 t, 24.09.2026, 7 arriving pax) and QAS-27306 (T7-KBI, CL605 21.9 t, 15.10.2026, 2 arriving pax). Handling by weight band: MTOW < 30 t 1,105, < 50 t 1,225. Preflight assistance (permit, slot, parking) 270, paperwork surcharge 80, pushback 270, communication 80, toilet 210, water 210, VIP bus 160. Airport fees: landing CL605 362.88, GL6T 733.87; ATC (up to 50 t) 66.37; per arriving pax 6.68. Concession fee 17% on all items (incl. airport fees and GAT) → disbursement 17% whole invoice. 4% commission for card payment (on total incl. concession; tick). Porter per arriving pax 11 (tick). GAT (passenger terminal) arrival: tiered tariff, price per person falls as pax count rises. From proformas: 2 pax 975, 7 pax 2,435 USD; invoice (T7-KBI, 15 Oct 2026): 3 pax 1,285; for other pax counts, until the full table arrives, by user decision 430 per person. 18% VAT on GAT (not in panel). Departure GAT not on proformas (0 departing pax). Israeli VAT 18% only on GAT and card commission. OWN (24 t) handling 1,105; FLH (34 t) and ALEX (42 t) 1,225 — QAS weight band applied with user approval. Weight-independent fixed items (preflight, paperwork, communication, pushback, toilet, water, VIP bus, ATC < 50 t, pax fees, GAT, porter, card) entered for these groups too. Landing known only for CL605 and GL6T. No QAS price for AFZ (53 t). AEROHANDLING: SGHA contract (ground handling up to 60 t 687 USD, annual 20–39 flights 5%, 40+ flights 10% discount; night departure 23:00–07:00 and weekend Friday 17:00–Sunday 07:00 and public holidays +130; royalty 14.95% on whole invoice excl. fuel; 3% for card payment) and invoices 6G0000132 (A6-AFO E35L), 155 (P4-BVY E35L), 157 and 190 (A6-AFC GLEX), 227 (T7-KBI CL60), 317 (A6-AFA GL6T, September). Landing CL60 417.31, E35L 454.41, GLEX/GL6T 843.95; parking every started 24 h CL60 104.33, E35L 113.60, GLEX 210.99 (1 day even for 40 min stay); ATC 76.33; per arriving pax 7.68, per departing pax airport tax 38.95, baggage handling per pax 12.54 (arrival and departure). Slots/permit/paperwork 141, pushback 165, lavatory 165. Fattal GA terminal pax fee from Fattal 2026 price list (1–15 pax tiered, arrival and departure separately); not on invoices for busy flights (AFO 15 pax, AFA 10 pax) — untick 'in total' if not used on that flight. Fattal crew terminal per direction up to 3 persons 347, extra person 56 (tick). By user decision September 2026 prices (invoice 317) used: handling 735 (687 in contract), pushback 175 (previously 165), landing permit & slots 155 (previously slots/permit/paperwork 141), documentation 40 (tick), ice 11, dishwashing 75. May–July invoices therefore differ with older prices. P4-BVY invoice 155: no royalty charged and night surcharge 168. Weekend calculated in panel as full Friday + Saturday (contract: Friday 17:00–Sunday 07:00). AEROHANDLING proforma (22 Oct 2026; A6-FLH GLF4, 21–23 Oct 2026, 2 + 2 pax, 4 crew, no times; Bedek Aviation template, not final; 5,473.62 + royalty 14.95% = 6,291.93 USD, +3% by card): FLH landing 639.91 and parking every started 24 h 159.98 added; night/weekend surcharge by user decision 130 → 168 (same as P4-BVY invoice; 130 in contract); water 155 (basket), GPU per hour 165 (basket), dishwashing 130 (previously 75); tick: escort to/from Shalom Gate 198, crew & passengers handling at Terminal 3 270 (user: important in Israel); ice row deleted by user decision. Fattal crew terminal on proforma 403 = 347 + 56 (4th crew). Panel matches proforma exactly (assumption 21.10 12:00 – 23.10 12:00, Friday departure weekend surcharge). QAS proforma QAS-27509 (4 Nov 2026; A6-AFO E35L 24.3 t, 4 Nov 18:50–19:50 UTC, 3 arriving pax, by card): handling 1,105, preflight 270, landing 395.14, ATC 66.37, arriving pax 3 × 6.68, porter 3 × 11, GAT 3 pax 1,285 (+18% VAT), paperwork 80, pushback 270, communication 80, toilet 210, VIP bus 160, water 210, card 4% 195.84, concession 17% 711.37; total 5,091.76 + VAT 266.55. Landing E35L 395.14 added; paperwork and communication moved to basket (previously outside basket). LAUFER (Laufer Aviation): proforma A6-AFO E35L, VABB–LLBG–OMRK, 7–9 Dec 2026, and Laufer GA/BA price list valid from 1 Jan 2026 (toilet, water, GPU; GL7T handling and pushback). Handling 770 (GL7T 1,000), pushback 180 (GL7T 220), landing permit & slots 150, toilet 150, water 150, GPU per hour 190; landing E35L 395.14, ATC 66.37, arriving pax 6.68, departing pax tax 33.87, parking E35L 98.79 per started 24 h; baggage handling 6.81 per pax each direction; Fattal GA terminal 11 pax 3,387 per direction (other pax counts 307.91 per pax, approx.); Fattal crew terminal 384 per direction; extra manpower 85 per leg with 7 or more pax. IAA 14.95% on handler items (airport fees excluded); administration fee 5% on airport fees and Fattal incl. IAA (5.748%); collection charge 4% (tick). Night 22:00–06:00, weekend and holiday surcharge 20%. Panel 12,488.59, proforma 12,488.55. QAS quote (A6-AFO E35L, VABB–LLBG–OMRK, 7–9 Dec 2026, 1 + 1 pax, total 6,682.26): VIP bus 160 per movement (2 movements 320); night surcharge 25% 22:00–06:00; GAT pax 1 pax 545 per direction, GAT departure row added; GAT crew terminal 380 per direction (arrival and departure rows); porter 11 per movement (qty = movements, row renamed from per arriving pax); departing pax tax 33.87; parking E35L 98.79 per started 24 h.
